title: 第19章 计划破产第20章 锒铛入狱
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 黑心商贩啊！真正的黑心商贩！
比对着手里灵宝商会的材料价目表和收购店各种材料的收购价，郑常恨不得原地立几个路灯。
收购价连商会售价的一半都没有！
要真的从灵宝商会买材料到收购店卖，就算材料翻倍还得亏进去一点。
天地良心啊，奸商也不能这么奸吧，哪怕你打六折呢，自己还能赚一成吧？
倒卖系统任务材料赚钱计划出师未捷身先死了。
当然，要是不经过灵宝商会和收购店，自己在集市收购和倒卖材料还是能赚的，要是黑市上，说不定能赚更多。
但那太麻烦也太危险了，难保不会被有心之人盯上，郑常是无论如何也不会考虑的。
既然倒卖系统材料的任务宣告破产了，系统心心念念的特殊筑基估计最多也只能下品特殊筑基了。
就算下品筑基都要五种材料，粗略估算也要四五百下品灵石。
自己还有三百下品灵石的缺口，怕是不容易啊。自己目前可没有赚灵石的法子。
不知道之后顺便完成的系统任务奖励能不能凑够这么多灵石。
别的不说，支线任务的奖励实在是比主线的要差太多了。
第一次做完主线任务得到的那个丹炉卖了两百，之前用剩下那张灵兽契约符卖给收购店只能卖两块灵石一张。
这系统的数值策划真的没问题吗？投入产出比设计得这么低，谁有动力完成任务啊。
自己真的能靠白嫖系统好好的观光吗？不会最后还是要打工吧？
“郑常，该寻地方落脚了吧，选个修士旅馆吧，那种旅馆里有聚灵阵，可以加快修炼的！”敖青提议道。
郑常眉头微皱：“那挺贵的吧？”
“不贵，最下等的单间三五块下品灵石就能住了，我刚刚看见了。”
“你就注意这些东西了？”
“不你说的吗？最重要是睡觉？”
“你那是为了睡觉吗？那我今晚不修炼了，住一晚你乐意吗？”
“……哥，没必要吧，那你不白花钱了？”
郑常叹了口气：“行吧，就试一试吧，反正也是一种全新的体验。”
风景、奇观、人文都是观光的一部分，郑常其实并不介意体验一下的，只是不希望被人强迫体验。
郑常带着敖青问了三家旅店，最终挑了一间只要两块灵石一晚的店。
当他被带到客房的时候，他才明白，什么叫做一分钱一分货。
上辈子出差得时候，什么老破小的宾馆郑常都住过。但再怎么差，床还是有的。
可眼前的房间，唯一的家具是一个打坐的蒲团。
“这位客官，这是房间的钥匙，若是损坏了需要赔偿一块下品灵石，饮食需要另外收费，请在明天午时前归还钥匙，超过半个时辰，押金不退。”
“小二，床呢？”郑常还是忍不住问道。
小二面露异色：“床？客官，你不是要的有聚灵阵的房间吗？”
“是啊，但你没床啊？”
你在有聚灵阵的房间里，不抓紧时间修炼，还打算睡觉的吗？有钱没地方花？
不对啊，真有钱没地方话你选咱这全城最便宜的聚灵阵房？
content_en:
Black-hearted merchant! A real evil dealer!
Comparing the material price list of the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce in his hand with the purchase price of various materials in the purchasing store, Zheng Chang wished he could put up a few street lamps in place.
The purchase price is not even half of the chamber’s selling price!
If you really want to buy materials from the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce and sell them at the purchasing store, you will still have to make a small loss even if the materials are doubled.
Conscience of heaven and earth, profiteers can't be so treacherous, right? Even if you give me a 40% discount, you can still make 10%, right?
The plan to make money by reselling system mission materials died before it even got off the ground.
Of course, if you don't go through the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce and the purchasing store, you can still make money by buying and reselling materials at the market. If you go to the black market, you might be able to make more.
But that would be too troublesome and dangerous, and there was no guarantee that someone would be interested in it. Zheng Chang would not consider it anyway.
Now that the task of reselling system materials has been declared bankrupt, the special foundation building that the system is so obsessed with may only be low-grade special foundation building at best.
Even if low-grade foundation building requires five materials, a rough estimate would require four to five hundred low-grade spiritual stones.
I still have a gap of three hundred low-grade spiritual stones, so I'm afraid it won't be easy. I currently have no way to earn spiritual stones.
I don’t know if the system task rewards that I will complete later will be enough to collect so many spirit stones.
Apart from anything else, the rewards for the side missions are really much worse than those for the main missions.
The alchemy furnace I got after completing the main quest for the first time was sold for two hundred. The remaining spirit beast contract talisman sold to the purchase shop could only be sold for two spirit stones per piece.
Is there really no problem with the numerical planning of this system? If the input-output ratio is so low as designed, who has the motivation to complete the task?
Can I really enjoy sightseeing by relying on the free prostitution system? You won’t have to work part-time in the end, right?
"Zheng Chang, it's time to find a place to stay. Choose a monk hotel. There is a spirit gathering array in that hotel, which can speed up your cultivation!" Ao Qing suggested.
Zheng Chang frowned slightly: "That's quite expensive, isn't it?"
"It's not expensive. You can live in the lowest-grade single room for just three or five low-grade spiritual stones. I just saw it."
"Is this all you pay attention to?"
"Isn't that what you said? The most important thing is to sleep?"
"Are you doing that to sleep? Then I won't practice tonight. Are you willing to stay one night?"
"...Brother, it's not necessary, then you won't spend money in vain?"
Zheng Chang sighed: "Okay, let's give it a try. It's a brand new experience anyway."
Scenery, wonders, and culture are all part of tourism. Zheng Chang actually doesn't mind experiencing them, but he just doesn't want to be forced to experience them.
Zheng Chang took Ao Qing to inquire about three hotels, and finally chose one that only cost two spiritual stones per night.
When he was taken to the guest room, he realized what it means to get what you pay for.
When he was on a business trip in his previous life, Zheng Chang stayed in all kinds of old and small hotels. But no matter how bad it is, there are still beds.
But the only furniture in the room in front of me was a futon for meditating.
"Sir, this is the key to the room. If it is damaged, you will need to pay for a low-grade spiritual stone. Food and beverages will be charged separately. Please return the key before noon tomorrow. If it exceeds half an hour, the deposit will not be refunded."
"Boy, where's the bed?" Zheng Chang couldn't help but ask.
The waiter had a strange look on his face: "Bed? Sir, don't you want a room with a spirit gathering array?"
"Yeah, but you don't have a bed?"
You are in a room with a spirit gathering array. If you don't seize the time to practice, are you still going to sleep? Have money but nowhere to spend it?
No, if you really have money and no room, why don’t you choose our cheapest Spirit Gathering Formation room in the city?
